sloka: हत्वा तं वानरैः सार्धं ननाद मुदितो हरिः।चुक्रोध च दशग्रीवो बभौ हृष्टश्च राघवः ।। ६.९८.३६ ।।
transliteration: hatvā taṁ vānaraiḥ sārdhaṁ nanāda mudito hariḥ।cukrodha ca daśagrīvo babhau hṛṣṭaśca rāghavaḥ ।। 6.98.36 ।।

translations.english: While Mahodara was extracting the sword stuck to the head, Sugriva, the elephant of the monkeys, severed the head of Mahodara which was decked with earrings and helmet.
